description: Check a screen you built or designed against eight experience requirements: confirmation before consequential actions, error state, empty state, loading state, undo or edit, sources on AI output, recovery after an AI error, consent before automation. Describe the screen as data (flow, components, actions with flags, states implemented) and get pass, fail or not_applicable per rule, each with the principle it comes from and its citations, plus a markdown summary. Call it after generating or changing a screen and fix every fail. Pro mode only (UXUI_API_KEY set); without a key use generate_checklist for the unevaluated checklist.

actions.description: The actions the screen offers, with their flags.

automated.description: True when it runs on the user's behalf, in the background, or uses their data to train or personalize.

consequential.description: True when it deletes, sends, pays, publishes or changes something the user cannot trivially get back.

components.description: What is on the screen, one item per component, in plain words (e.g., "search input", "results table", "AI summary panel"). Words such as form, table, list, search, chart, AI, chat or summary decide which rules apply.

flow.description: The flow the screen belongs to. One of: "onboarding", "forms", "pricing", "dashboard", "empty-states", "checkout", "settings", "navigation", "search", "authentication", "notifications", "data-tables". Other values are accepted and match no flow rule.

locale.description: Language of the verdicts and the summary: "en" or "es". Defaults to "en".

states_implemented.description: The states the implementation has: loading, empty, error, success, confirmation, undo, edit, sources, recovery, consent. Only list what is built.

name: check_requirements
title: Check a screen against the required-state rules
